overall: The Board violated the Open Meeting Law by holding its August 12, 2021 open session remotely without real-time public access; intent was not found, other allegations were declined, and compliance was ordered.

allegations.summary: The August 12 remote select board meeting gave the public no means to access the open session in real time, and the notice gave no access information.
allegations.key_passage: None of these facts relieves the Board of its obligation to provide the public with real-time access to its open session proceedings.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board acted intentionally in violating the law, citing the pre-meeting emails about access information.
allegations.key_passage: Instead, we find that the Board seriously—but sincerely—misunderstood the requirements of the Open Meeting Law and Chapter 20 to provide real-time access to its meetings.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged issues about public comment and who may speak at a meeting; the AG declined to review.
allegations.key_passage: None of these allegations, even if true, constitute violations of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged issues about posting meeting minutes to a website; the AG declined to review.
allegations.key_passage: None of these allegations, even if true, constitute violations of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to address certain topics; the AG declined to review.
allegations.key_passage: None of these allegations, even if true, constitute violations of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged issues about the order in which notice topics were taken up; the AG declined to review.
allegations.key_passage: None of these allegations, even if true, constitute violations of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: An additional allegation raised for the first time in the request for further review was not in the original complaint to the Board.
allegations.key_passage: Because this allegation was not raised in an Open Meeting Law complaint filed with the Board, we decline to review it.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
